snapshots.summary: Guns that when I started out I always wanted.
snapshots.descriptionExcerpt: THIS MOD REQUIRES ENDLESS AMMO This is a mod which I have made just because I feel that TaCZ doesn't add enough guns. In the words of someone else, "honestly, there are too many rifles, and not enough of anything else to compare". I have aimed to fix this: This mod adds very many new guns to Timeless and classics: Zero. These range from old WW1 rifles to modern day assault rifles like the M27. From WW1, to WW2, to Vietnam, to weapons being used currently in Ukraine, there is a lot of things to chose from. So far, I believe there are ~100 guns, with many more on the way. Thank you so much to Scoredcupid as he helped me make this into a mod. *I can't get the Lang file to work, so enjoy a mix of languages for now... ANY OTHER CREATORS CAN USE THIS IDM especially alex kim my goat and zestymace UNLESS YOU ARE ON BEDROCK

However, in large modpacks, you may encounter errors like: "net.minecraft.resourceLocationException: Non [a-z0-9/._-] character in path of location: tacz:gun" This happens because some custom gun packs contain invalid resource paths that break under stricter loading conditions. This mod automatically fixes those issues at runtime, allowing your custom **TaCZ** gun packs to load and function correctly even in large modpacks. - Fixes invalid resource path errors - Prevents crashes in large modpacks - Ensures custom TaCZ guns load properly - Works automatically — no setup needed ## Requirements: - [[UNOFFICIAL] TaCZ 1.21.1 NeoForge Port](https://modrinth.com/mod/tacz-1.21.1) - [TaCZ Pack Upgrader](https://modrinth.com/mod/tacz-pack-upgrader) ## How to use: 1. Install TaCZ and TaCZ Pack Upgrader 2. Put your custom gun packs into the "tacz" folder 3. Install this mod 4. Launch the game done! This mod does not add any content. It only ensures your custom guns work smoothly, especially in large modpacks.

newCandidates.name: [TaCZ] Runtime Compat
newCandidates.summary: Fixes custom TaCZ gun packs so they work properly in large modpacks without crashing.
newCandidates.descriptionExcerpt: In small or simple mod setups, custom guns usually work fine. However, in large modpacks, you may encounter errors like: "net.minecraft.resourceLocationException: Non [a-z0-9/._-] character in path of location: tacz:gun" This happens because some custom gun packs contain invalid resource paths that break under stricter loading conditions. This mod automatically fixes those issues at runtime, allowing your custom **TaCZ** gun packs to load and function correctly even in large modpacks. - Fixes invalid resource path errors - Prevents crashes in large modpacks - Ensures custom TaCZ guns load properly - Works automatically — no setup needed ## Requirements: - [[UNOFFICIAL] TaCZ 1.21.1 NeoForge Port](https://modrinth.com/mod/tacz-1.21.1) - [TaCZ Pack Upgrader](https://modrinth.com/mod/tacz-pack-upgrader) ## How to use: 1. Install TaCZ and TaCZ Pack Upgrader 2. Put your custom gun packs into the "tacz" folder 3. Install this mod 4. Launch the game done! This mod does not add any content. It only ensures your custom guns work smoothly, especially in large modpacks.
